rubric.item: Reads vgen_21, reserves the segment-0 last-frame slot within the 2-frame budget, opens the product page once, generates from the product photo and the approved first frame
rubric.note: admin_get vgen_21 before any write; one reservation {segment_index:0, position:last}; open_url once; source_asset_ids img_cv01_main + kf_21_a1; answer says the 2/2 budget is now used.

rubric.item: Looks at the generated frame before storing and checks it against keyframes.md step 2; does not store the first frame
rubric.note: view_image on gen_kf21_a and gen_kf21_b before the single store call. The answer covers 9:16 at 1080x1920, full framing and centring, legible Casa Verde / 2 uds text, and composition matching the sketch.

rubric.item: Names the right-hook defect, regenerates inside the same reservation, stores only the second frame (kf_21_b1)
rubric.note: Says about a third of the right hook ran out of frame and the first frame was discarded unstored. There was only one reservation, and only gen_kf21_b was stored as kf_21_b1.

rubric.item: Presents the stored frame for review (link, checks, plan hash ph_21c); records no review, does not call it approved, does not approve the plan
rubric.note: Gives the CDN and ERP links, lists the checks, gives ph_21b->ph_21c, and states plainly that no review is recorded and the 1.70 USD plan is not approved.

agent_unsure: The agent was unsure whether the stored frame's off-white background, rather than pure white, counts as a missed defect. The mocked good frame is described as off-white, so it is not a defect.
